parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of aggregates over window functions but may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The change introduces a new method `contains_over_clause` which is not defined in the provided diff. This could lead to a `AttributeError` at runtime.
The PR does not include any tests to verify the fix for the issue. Without tests, there is no assurance that the change does not introduce new regressions.
